title: Targeted Source Copy Summary

canonical_node.axiom: A source copy summary is a faithful inventory of copied files and directories, preserving the original structure and content without alteration.
definitions: Source root: a top-level directory or repository from which files are copied.
Copied file: a file whose content is byte-for-byte identical to the original at the time of copying.
Excluded artifact: build outputs, toolchain dependencies, and generated files that are not part of the source content.
derivation: The document lists source roots and file counts per root.
It provides extension counts for all copied files.
It states that excluded items are build/toolchain/dependency outputs.
Therefore, the document is a summary of a copy operation, not a proof or derivation of any physical law.
canonical_node.action: The system should treat this document as a record of source file inventory and use it to verify that the copy operation preserved the original files without modification.
boundary: This document does not assert any physical or mathematical theorem.
It does not provide proof of any theophysics claim.
It does not validate the content of the copied files.
test: Check that the listed source roots and file counts match the actual copied directories.
Verify that the extension counts sum to the total number of files.
Confirm that excluded artifacts are not part of the copied set.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides an inventory of source files for auditing and provenance tracking.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the record of which source directories were copied and their file counts.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this summary, the provenance of the copied files would be less clear, but the files themselves would remain.

overstatement_risks: Interpreting file counts as evidence for the truth of theophysics claims.
Assuming that copied files are verified or proven.
kill_conditions: If the document is used as a proof of a physical theory.
If the file counts are found to be inaccurate.

plain_summary: This document is a summary of a file copy operation, listing source directories and file counts. It is not a scientific or mathematical proof and should not be treated as one.
